summary: Completed testing of Coupon Management API and PayPal Sandbox Integration. All 23 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend coupon UI and PayPal Sandbox redirect working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Coupon API properly validates discount_type (percentage/fixed), min_amount, max_discount, expiry_date, and applicable_plans
Coupon validation correctly calculates discounts with max_discount cap for percentage coupons
PayPal is now using REAL PayPal Sandbox API - redirects to sandbox.paypal.com (not simulation)
Stripe checkout correctly applies coupon discounts before creating checkout session
Frontend coupon UI shows applied coupon with green checkmark, discount amount, and final price
PayPal shows 'Sandbox' badge clearly visible to users
PayPalReturnPage correctly handles payment capture with paymentId and PayerID params
seed_data_creation: Seeded 4 default coupons via POST /api/coupons/seed-defaults: WELCOME10 (10% off), SAVE20 (20% off, min $50), FLAT25 ($25 off, min $100), ENTERPRISE50 (50% off, enterprise plans only)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coupon and PayPal Sandbox features fully tested. Routes: /payment (PaymentPage with coupon input), /payment/paypal-return (PayPalReturnPage). Backend endpoints: POST /api/coupons/create, GET /api/coupons/list, POST /api/coupons/validate, POST /api/coupons/seed-defaults, PUT /api/coupons/{code}, DELETE /api/coupons/{code}, POST /api/payments/paypal/create-checkout (real PayPal Sandbox), POST /api/payments/create-checkout (Stripe with coupon support). PayPal is now using REAL Sandbox API - redirects to sandbox.paypal.com.

POST /api/coupons/seed-defaults.details: Seeds 4 default coupons (WELCOME10, SAVE20, FLAT25, ENTERPRISE50)

POST /api/coupons/create.details: Creates percentage and fixed discount coupons with all validation

GET /api/coupons/list.details: Lists all active coupons, supports include_inactive param

POST /api/coupons/validate.details: Validates coupon with package_id and amount, calculates discount correctly

coupon_validation_rules.percentage_discount: PASS - Correctly calculates percentage with max_discount cap
coupon_validation_rules.fixed_discount: PASS - Correctly applies fixed amount discount
coupon_validation_rules.min_amount_check: PASS - Rejects coupons when order below min_amount
coupon_validation_rules.plan_restriction: PASS - ENTERPRISE50 only works on enterprise plans

POST /api/payments/paypal/create-checkou.details: Creates real PayPal Sandbox payment, returns approval_url to sandbox.paypal.com

PayPal redirect.details: Successfully redirects to https://www.sandbox.paypal.com with valid token

POST /api/payments/create-checkout.details: Creates Stripe checkout with coupon discount applied

features: Displays all 15 subscription packages (3 plans x 5 durations)
Coupon Code input field with Apply button
Shows 'Coupon Applied' message with green checkmark when valid
Displays Original Price, Discount amount, and Final Total
Remove button to clear applied coupon
Proceed to Payment button redirects to PayPal Sandbox
Handles paymentId and PayerID from PayPal redirect
Shows error state when params missing
Try Again button navigates back to /payment
